YOUR INFORMATION

Privacy notice

How information shared through Kamilla Akhmedova’s website is used and handled.

What we collect

Inquiry forms collect your name, contact details, contact preferences, language, borough, and the program or work opportunity you ask about. The aide form also collects certifications, experience, optional comments, and an optional résumé. Hosting and security providers process connection details such as IP addresses to operate the website and prevent abuse.

Why we use it

We use this information to respond to your inquiry, discuss support or work opportunities, arrange follow-up, and protect the forms against spam and misuse. Sending an inquiry does not confirm program eligibility, services, employment, or an appointment.

Who can access it

Kamilla and people authorized to help manage the website and inquiries can access submissions. Notifications are sent to the configured email recipients. Résumés are stored separately in private Netlify storage and can be downloaded for review; they are not published on the website.

How long we keep it

We use purpose-based retention rather than a fixed number of days. We keep inquiries and résumés while they are needed to respond and follow up. Records are reviewed and deleted when no longer needed for those purposes. This includes associated stored files, upload permits, and retained email copies.

Questions or requests about your information

Contact Kamilla to ask about information you submitted, request a copy or correction, or ask for deletion. Include your contact details and the approximate date of your inquiry so it can be located. Please do not send identity documents to make a request.

Services used by this website

Netlify hosts the website and stores form submissions and private uploads. Email providers handle notification messages. Google reCAPTCHA helps prevent automated submissions, and Google Fonts supplies the website fonts. These providers process information under their own policies. reCAPTCHA is subject to Google’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

Netlify Privacy Policy · Google Privacy Policy · Google Terms of Service

Please keep inquiries general

Do not submit medical records, diagnoses, Medicaid or Social Security numbers, financial details, or identification documents through these forms or ordinary email. Ask Kamilla how to share any documents that may be needed later.
